run_eval_det_cls: run eval_det_cls to compute precision, recall, and average precision for a single object detection class
run_eval_det: run eval_det to compute precision, recall, and average precision across multiple object detection classes
run_eval_det_multiprocessing: run eval_det_multiprocessing to compute detection metrics across multiple classes using 10 parallel worker processes
run_voc_ap: run voc_ap to compute VOC average precision from precision and recall arrays with optional 11-point metric
run_get_iou: run get_iou or get_iou_obb to compute 3D bounding box IoU between two boxes
